title: Word building
summary: Build new words with six everyday suffixes: `-lI` and `-sIz` (*şekerli*, *şekersiz*, *İstanbullu*), `-CI` for trades and shops (*gazeteci*, *kitapçı*), `-lIk` (*güzellik*, *gözlük*, *bir haftalık*), `-CA` for languages and opinions (*Almanca*, *bence*), and `-(ş)Ar` for **each** (*birer*, *ikişer*).
canDo: Say where people are from, and describe things with and without something
Name jobs, shops and the people who work in them
Name languages and give your opinion
Order for a group and bargain at a market
